desc:
WW2 tank battles where one good shot can end the fight! 💥

Angle your armor, aim for weak spots, and knock out enemy tanks with a single well-placed shot. Push with your team, flank the enemy, or hold an ambush position. Just don't show your side!

🎖️ Win battles, earn badges, and level up.
🎙️ Voice chat supported!

Still in development: expect regular updates, balance changes, and new content. Join our Discord to report bugs and suggest features!

⚠️ Exploiting the game or its mechanics will result in moderation ⚠️

Enjoy :D
